steps.content: Those shrill alarms and PA announcements feel like a thing of the past. Today, only the faint clamor from the distant Recreation Area can be heard.

As you watch the passing staff members and Sinners, you can't help but sigh. It feels like ages have passed since you last had such a leisurely day. You've been so busy with work running around DisCity that it seems like you're out of touch with the daily lives of your subordinates.
Heading toward the Recreation Area, you notice a group of staff members huddling together. They're watching something on a screen and discussing. Intrigued, you join them.
Scene Change - DeadLover Radio

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hi everyone! You've tuned into DeadLover Radio!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: How can such a major radio station not have a live chat system...? Are you guys fans of that Nin... Uh, what's her name again?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Nino.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Ah, right, Nino!

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: It's been over a year and you still haven't come up with such a simple function...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: <size=30>Lil Daisy!</size> Forget about that. I've heard rumors about some paranormal event in Eastside?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Ghost Calls.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Yeah, yeah, Ghost Calls. Let's get into that before anyone else does! We don't want those Eastside hosts stealing our thunder with some lame jokes. You know how uncreative and shameless people can be!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: I suggest they come and take a look around Syndicate. Experience the great wisdom of this wonderful place.

In true DeadLover Radio style, the interesting duo goes all out for a fun time. This time, they're mocking the Eastside hosts to spice up the conversation, even incorporating some physical gestures into their act.
Live chat messages keep rolling quickly over the screen.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Though I know she's deliberately stirring up controversy for views, it kinda rubs me the wrong way as a fan of Nino Sama.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Nino Sama hasn't been live for almost three days. She should respond to that soon, right?

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: Huh? Are you seriously addressing her as your superior? Just how crazy are you about this streamer named Nino?

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Oh, everyone calls her that. It's just a nickname.
Both the Nino mentioned by DeadLover Radio and the Nino the staff members are talking about intrigue you greatly.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm a virtual host. When I was live streaming today, I really got a ******* call at 3 a.m.!
Where did she run off to after you two split up? Although you know nothing about her abilities, judging by how effectively she escaped, she's probably on par with an S-Class Sinner.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The name you just mentioned... sounds familiar. She...

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: Oh, Chief, you're here. You... you like watching this kind of stuff too?
At that moment, the screen flickers with static and the dancing radio host is suddenly replaced by a girl whose face you're too familiar with.
Simultaneously, all the screens in the rest area switch to the girl's livestream.
Even the phones' lock screens have been hacked. Clearly, it takes a highly skilled hacker to do this, or...

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Yesss! It's Nino Sama! You came back finally! I've been dying to see you...
Or, a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ding dong, ding dong! This is normally Nino Sama's gaming time, but...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: A fan just DM-ed me that the DeadLover Radio hosts were dissing Eastside hosts in their livestream?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You guys do make me laugh sometimes, you know. I'm not saying your show itself is funny. It's just the way you genuinely think your cringey crap is hilarious that cracks me up. It's too laughable.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But that can't be helped, can it? After all, that hellhole Syndicate only produces hellish thugs like you. We're too civilized to understand your savage antics.
A few threatening personal attacks flash across the live chat, egging the girl on further.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Be careful when you go out... Don't get beaten up in a sack in Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You think I'd be scared? I'm a ******* Sinner! You don't wanna **** with me!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Warning to the host: Please avoid inappropriate speech.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Cough, cough... You didn't hear... Cough... anything just now...
She turns off her model and starts coughing, not even managing to turn off her microphone in time.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Cough, cough... You didn't hear... Cough... anything just now...
She turns off her model and starts coughing, not even managing to turn off her microphone in time.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm fine... I'm not sick, it's just that these ******** are irritating me too much...
Even the phones' lock screens have been hacked. Clearly, it takes a highly skilled hacker to do this, or...

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Yesss! It's Nino Sama! You came back finally! I've been dying to see you...
Or, a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ding dong, ding dong! This is normally Nino Sama's gaming time, but...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: A fan just DM-ed me that the DeadLover Radio hosts were dissing Eastside hosts in their livestream?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You guys do make me laugh sometimes, you know. I'm not saying your show itself is funny. It's just the way you genuinely think your cringey crap is hilarious that cracks me up. It's too laughable.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But that can't be helped, can it? After all, that hellhole Syndicate only produces hellish thugs like you. We're too civilized to understand your savage antics.
A few threatening personal attacks flash across the live chat, egging the girl on further.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Be careful when you go out... Don't get beaten up in a sack in Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You think I'd be scared? I'm a ******* Sinner! You don't wanna **** with me!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm fine... I'm not sick, it's just that these ******** are irritating me too much...
Her provocative remarks have caught the attention of the staff and Sinners in the Bureau. Of course, some also join in the cheering and applause.
The arrogant attitude and cheeky behavior can't be mistaken. This must be Nino the Sinner.
After escaping, not only has she not been hiding her identity, but she also broadcasts her livestream directly in the Bureau...
It's a rather blatant provocation directed at you, the MBCC's Chief.
This is also the first time you've seen a virtual host like this. Normally, the virtual image should differ greatly from the real person...
But the Nino in front of you is streaming with a virtual image that looks almost identical to herself, which is indeed rare.

You shake your head, clearing out the chaotic thoughts. The primary objective now is to detain the known Sinner, especially one who has escaped while being under your watch. You turn to give your order to the staff members.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Notify Adjutant Nightingale to get ready. I have somewhere to go now.

steps.speaker: Staff Members A & B
steps.content: Yes, Chief!
Scene Change - Black Screen

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Let's say Chief brings Nino Sama back, do you think I can just go up and ask her for an autograph?

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: ...You need to chill.
(Scene change)
It's 11 p.m., and you've arrived at an old, remote neighborhood in Eastside. According to the investigation, this area is mostly inhabited by elderly people.
And according to the location tracked using the livestream data, Nino is hiding here.
To stay updated, you have Nino's livestream playing on the device in your hand. She's playing a game while continuously berating her teammates.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oi, oi, how can you guys be so **** at this game? Noobs! Losers! Nino Sama is carrying you to victory and you can't even just lie down and play dead?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You don't know what a ping is and all you do is obsess over the damn DPS. When you see the red circle, move! I can't carry your ass out of the boss's range every time!

steps.speaker: Live Chat
steps.content: There it is, the host is roasting her teammates again.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm just being honest. When Nino Sama points out others' problems, it's always backed by proof. I'll never accuse someone of what they didn't do.

steps.speaker: Live Chat
steps.content: But you can't keep insulting your teammates!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But think about it! If I don't tell them what they've done wrong, they might not realize their own problems. I'm only helping them improve! It's for their own good. They should thank me!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Like I always say, if you suck, just practice more!

steps.speaker: Live Chat
steps.content: Stop yelling so loudly at this hour. Aren't you afraid the neighbors may complain about the noise?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ahem, <size=29>they better not. There's an old lady living next door, but I've been streaming late at night for so long and she's never come over to knock on my door.</size>

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: <size=29>The buildings around here have really good soundproofing... I guess?</size>

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Even though she's so old that she can barely move around... she always greets people cheerfully.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Why does she try so hard...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Given her personality, even if my streaming indeed is a tiny bit noisy, she... she probably...
On the screen, the usually overbearing Nino Sama surprisingly seems somewhat hesitant.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hey, I've only said like two sentences and my ******* teammate died on me again?!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Damn it! Now that I'm pissed, I'm even hungrier. Why hasn't my takeout arrived yet? Nino Sama is going to starve to death! Help!
(Scene change)
The next moment, a deliveryman in Supereats uniform is seen jogging toward the residential area, carefully holding a takeout box, afraid of spilling the soup and getting a bad review.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Excuse me. We are conducting an investigation and need to requisition what you're holding.
You point at the takeout in his hand.

steps.speaker: Deliveryman
steps.content: Uh... is this some kind of new scam? No way, are you even going after a takeout?

steps.speaker: Deliveryman
steps.content: Wow, there are quite a lot of you. Is this some new prank show? Please let me go, I'm really busy. This order is about to be overdue and I'll be penalized for being late!

steps.speaker: Deliveryman
steps.content: See, the customer is texting to ask where I am again. That's really not cool, you guys prank us for fun in these shows and ignore our feelings...
Worried that his loud voice may alert the target, you have no choice but to show your badge.

steps.speaker: Deliveryman
steps.content: Holy ****, you are indeed a cop! What kind of big trouble have I gotten into?
The deliveryman's phone rings. Presumably the famous streamer upstairs can't wait any longer. You gesture for the deliveryman to keep quiet and hand the phone to you.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hey, what's going on with you guys? Where's my food?! Doesn't your company like to brag about punctual delivery? I'm so hungry I don't even have the energy to roast these ******* teammates anymore.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm filing a complaint! I'm giving you a bad review!
As soon as you pick up the phone, her roar pierces through the receiver. The deliveryman next to you grows even more anxious upon hearing about the bad review.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Apologize, then make up an excuse

choices.text: Apologize, then make up an excuse

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm really sorry, ma'am. There was a traffic jam on the way here. The sheriffs were chasing a criminal and blocked off the neighborhood, so I had to take a detour... That's why I'm late.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Okay, I see... I guess that can't be helped. I won't give you a bad review in that case. But... just hurry up! I'm starving to death!
She's surprisingly reasonable. It's time to move on to the next step.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, ma'am, I'm almost there. Can you please open the gate for me?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Tsk, what a hassle. Hold on for a sec... Okay, you can come up, I'm really busy right now.
"Sheriff"
You've taken the deliveryman's jacket and draped it over yourself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ma'am, I think your doorbell is out of order. I can't open the gate. Could you come down to get it?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Out of order? That's impossible. It was working fine when I went out last night.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ugh... Damn it! I'm really busy right now and I'm about to take on the next boss. And I still have to set up the formation for these idiots!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Then you can ring the doorbell of my neighbor and let her try to open the door.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Uh-huh.
There's a few seconds of hesitation on the other end of the phone before she speaks again.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ah! Never mind... It's late, I'll come down myself.
Nino glances at the time at the bottom right corner of the screen. It's now 11:57 p.m.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Don't ring it! Don't touch anything! Wait for me for two minutes, just two minutes! Once I'm done with the formation, I'll come down to collect it myself.
Scene Change - A flash of black screen
A few minutes later, the tapping footsteps approach and the streamer girl flings the door open loudly.

Despite the impatience and reluctance written all over her face, she still doesn't have the heart to disturb her neighbor's rest and has chosen to leave her room and come downstairs to get the takeout herself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Here's the sushi and happy chicken and coke combo you've ordered. Enjoy your meal...
You recite the takeout order and hand over the food in your hand.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Alright, don't bother with that! I already said I won't give you a bad review! I'm in a hurry.
As she grabs the food and is about to leave, you quietly look up. When your eyes meet, she suddenly realizes something.
You step forward quickly and grab her wrist holding the takeout, the power of the shackles activating instantly.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You're that cop... No! Chief...!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You bastard! How dare you... trick me!
You've managed to ambush Nino, but she's struggling with all her might, forcing her power out and trying to break free from the shackles.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Let go of me...!
This is the first time you've faced this level of resistance from an A-Class Sinner. After dodging Nino's attack, you quickly call for the arrest crew behind you.
As the loud noise echoes in the night sky, lights are being turned on in the apartments, and figures begin to gather at the windows.

steps.content: Uh... You...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Uh... You...
The hidden arrest crew activates the Anti-Mania device and instantly subdues Nino before she begins resisting violently.
Despite the unexpected twists and turns, the arrest operation has been a great success.
Nino slumps to the ground, the last thing reflected in her hazy eyes the sushi, fried chicken, and coke spilled all over the floor.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Nino...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Tell me, what did you do?

choices.text: Tell me, what did you do?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: No!! I did nothing! I was just livestreaming normally like I always do!!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Nino stomps her foot, still looking like an angry guinea pig.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Livestreaming normally? Then why was the livestream broadcast to totally unrelated devices? Here, have a look.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
You pick up a thick stack of files on the side and put them on the desk in front of her.
Most of these are in fact complaint letters. Apparently, the livestream platform and the Public Security Bureau have long had a grudge against her.

steps.speaker: Complaint Letter
steps.content: I was watching someone else's livestream when suddenly it was switched to this Nino's channel. This is malicious advertising!

steps.speaker: Complaint Letter
steps.content: For a while, my TV would automatically turn on at 9 p.m. and show me this Nino's game channel. I couldn't even turn it off!

steps.speaker: Complaint Letter
steps.content: Does my refrigerator have its own mind now? Every evening, the LCD screen automatically plays this Nino's livestream, and the vegetables inside have all gone bad!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Cough, cough...
Seeing the mountain of complaint letters, she suddenly starts coughing like she's choked on something.
She's been coughing a lot lately. Did she catch a cold? She seemed perfectly fine when you were together before.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ...They complained about me because I trash-talked my teammates during the livestream? They sure have a lot of time on their hands.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Do these haters have nothing better to do than sit around on my channel all day, looking for something to pick on?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Besides that, your ability must have contributed to this too. If you could broadcast your livestream into a high-security facility like the Bureau...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That means you're used to...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Cough... About my ability, I made that up during a livestream! Hey Chief, buddy, you know this is all just for show, right?
steps.female_content: Cough... About my ability, I made that up during a livestream! Hey Chief, sis, you know this is all just for show, right?

steps.content: She hastily interrupts you, trying to play it down.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: It's just a gimmick. I've said it so much that the audience doesn't believe it anymore. I didn't expect you to take it seriously.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Maybe... maybe something went wrong! Besides, couldn't there be someone within the streaming platform who really, really liked my livestream and decided to give me a big boost? And just happened to broadcast it elsewhere?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Here's a fine issued to you by the streaming platform.

choices.text: Here's a fine issued to you by the streaming platform.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The livestream aside, the fact that you were able to escape from that place and elude me... already proves that you're not ordinary.
Let's drop the pretense and speak plainly.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Tsk.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: So what? I've neither stolen anything nor robbed anyone. I just want more people to watch my livestream!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: A lot of people love my stuff! Just look at the live chat of my videos and see for yourself!
She eagerly pulls out her phone and shows you the screen. The comments are all over the place, but there are indeed a lot of viewers discussing the content of the stream seriously.
But you're only looking at the outcome of the positive side of her power.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You may not know this, but during one of your horror game livestreams, you activated your ability, affecting the communication devices over a large area, including a nursing home that was holding a charity event. Several elderly people were badly shocked and some of them were even rushed to the emergency room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Although none of them ended up severely harmed, but...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Those are just isolated incidents, accidents! Look at those Eastsiders, aren't they all into this sort of thing?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Like that scary art museum, and that drink that can make you dream constantly. To this day, they are still popular topics on Dismyth!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: A little sacrifice for that isn't entirely unacceptable, is it?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Everyone loves exciting games and shows, and my ability just happens to allow everyone to see me and accept me, and to let everyone see the show they love!
As the young girl in front of you says this, her eyes seem to glow like flames.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: It seems like you have a big problem with the livestreaming industry, Chief!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're exaggerating. I only disapprove of your streaming style. I don't have any issues with the streaming industry.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You disapprove of my streaming style? Have you ever watched my livestream?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've only watched it twice, and only because it was related to my work.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, I've been too busy lately.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: So you're denying my effort based on these complaints while you've never even watched my livestream?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You should go and download my most watched recorded video. It's pinned on my personal page. Your life is incomplete if you haven't watched it!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: After that, even a boring stiff like you will fall for Nino Sama!
For some reason, whenever she talks about anything related to livestreaming, she gets very excited. For the sake of the investigation, you hesitate for a moment and still open up the recorded video.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hold on, you must like, subscribe, and share before you start watching. How can you lack such basic etiquette as a viewer?

steps.speaker: Chief
options: Keep talking and I'll turn it off.

choices.text: Keep talking and I'll turn it off.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Tsk.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Yup, that's it!
You play the video, which is the recording of an online carnival.

A regular girl armed with a pixelated sword-shield is desperately fighting against the overwhelming Mania. The video is filled with chaotic shouts and screams and the quality is low, but you can still feel the intense survival instinct bursting out of her frail body through the screen.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I can't die... I won't die!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ******* Corruptors! I swear I'll destroy you! Even if it costs me my life!

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Roarrrr—
Each frame seems to be filled with an ordinary person's hope and desire for survival. The girl bravely resisting the Mania with her sword-shield is none other than Nino.
Under the video are numerous related fan works based on this very video, such as edits, MADs, and illustrated clips...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Last time I checked, there were 26 million views. Now it's reached 29 million and pushing 30 million. 30 million! Do you have any idea what that means?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: So? Have you fallen in love with me? Are you now a fan of Nino Sama?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ...Even if you don't like me, there are plenty of people who do!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: One day, my perfect livestream will win everyone over, even you!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I mean, I just haven't had the chance to show it off. If I could find the right opportunity...
She emphasizes the latter part of the sentence.
She's showing you her videos and dropping such obvious hints all for one purpose...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Just say you want to do a livestream.

choices.text: Just say you want to do a livestream.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ahem, you guessed it. Not gonna lie, I'm having withdrawal symptoms!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Dear Chief! Look, the MBCC is so luxurious and grand, don't you want to show it off to the outsiders? And don't forget about yourself, the charismatic, mysterious Chief. If you show up as my livestream guest... Think of the attention and views it'll draw! It's almost unimaginable!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: My views have reached a bottleneck recently. Why don't you collab with me? Let's do a livestream together? I'm sure my popularity will skyrocket!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Pretty please, Chief!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Give up. I won't give you the chance to abuse your ability.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You better think carefully, dear Chief! I have nearly a million fans online. If they find out I'm being held here... what consequences could there be?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Even if they don't know where I am, once the news of my disappearance gets out and continues to brew, who knows what kind of action my fans may take?
Public opinion. There it is again.
Although this Sinner's ability is not dangerous, she can indeed cause social disturbances. And when people gather in crowds, their destructive power increases exponentially.
More importantly, you still haven't figured out why a mere A-Class Sinner was able to temporarily block your shackles.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But we need to set some ground rules.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: For real? Yes! Deal, deal! Whatever rules you want!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Doesn't matter I'm locked up here if I get to keep streaming and having fun!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: First, you cannot reveal your location.

choices.text: First, you cannot reveal your location.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: During the livestream, you can't say that you're at the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hmm... No problem, I can keep a secret!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Second, control yourself during the livestream.

choices.text: Second, control yourself during the livestream.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What? I'm not that kind of streamer, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I mean control your ability. Don't broadcast your livestream to other places again.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ...Alright, no problem.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Third, I must be there while you're livestreaming.

choices.text: Third, I must be there while you're livestreaming.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ugh...
The previously obedient Nino who kept nodding suddenly looks somewhat conflicted.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's wrong?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm supposed to be single... Having an extra person sitting next to me on the livestream seems a bit problematic.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh my! Chief, that's the kind of stuff you're into!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll take back my promise if you keep talking nonsense.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Don't! I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: By the way...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Is the Chief of the MBCC not ashamed of tricking a delicate beautiful streamer under the guise of a food delivery person?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Or is the Chief that much of a wimp that you dare not confront me head-on?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's a necessary measure.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And you, why do you stream with a virtual image that looks almost exactly like yourself?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: As if I'll tell you!
The big-name streamer makes a face at you.
